stories.title: Leading China Property Developer Reports Huge loss, in Sign of Widening Real-Estate Woes
stories.summary: Chinese property developer Vanke reported a large loss, adding to signs that the country’s real-estate crisis is widening. Its troubles raise questions about how far the crisis will spread and whether the Chinese state will intervene.

stories.title: Freed Israeli Hostages Still Had Shrapnel in Their Bodies From Oct. 7 Attack
stories.summary: Some freed Israeli women still had shrapnel in their bodies from the October 7 attack, according to an Israeli medical official. The official said some were held alone for long periods and spent eight months in tunnels.

links.excerpt: Some of the women were held alone for extended periods and spent eight months in tunnels, an Israeli medical official said.
